title: Attend your appointment at the Questura
whatHappens: When you submit your Kit Giallo at the post office, you get a receipt with a date to appear at the Questura (immigration office) for fingerprinting and photo identification — the last step to actually receive your permit.
whoDecides: The Questura schedules the date; you can't choose it.
timing: Usually a few weeks after you submit your Kit Giallo — the receipt itself lets you stay legally in the meantime.
whatKimereDoes: We tell you what to bring and what to expect, so the appointment is routine instead of stressful.
